records.title: Minimum MP4 duration and frame preservation
records.rule: Reject undersized MP4 before dispatch; preserve canonical captured frames once when lowering playback fps.
records.absence_reason: Measured on w7/live/example_game/clean_0 (clip duration 0.367s rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT 400).
records.negative_contrast: Short valid-frame clip meets duration with same count / remux of undersized clip is rejected.
records.mitigation: When frames / fps < 1.0s, encode at framerate = max(1, floor(frames / 1.0)) to ensure duration >= 1.0s while keeping every frame exactly once.
records.closure: Pre-dispatch validation rejects MP4 with duration < 1.0s; video re-encoding enforces >= 1.0s playback duration.

records.title: Literal UTF-8 media path serialization
records.absence_reason: Observed in w7 prompt generation where ensure_ascii=True escaped a non-ASCII home path to non-literal unicode.
records.negative_contrast: Non-ASCII directory appears literally / escaped path does not count as accessible evidence.
records.mitigation: Render media block in judge prompt using json.dumps with ensure_ascii=False.
records.closure: Covered by prompt serialization unit tests with non-ASCII directory paths.

records.title: Configurable direct worker argv and lifetime boundary
records.rule: Configurable direct bounded worker argv and agy path; transport wrapper lifetime must cover declared deadline.
records.absence_reason: newton run default was bounded by ~50s cut, shorter than the 180s judge call deadline.
records.negative_contrast: Environment/policy override reaches selected transport / unavailable path stops, not fallback.
records.mitigation: Read direct worker path from GODOT_VISUAL_QA_GEMINI_WORKER and agy shim from GODOT_VISUAL_QA_AGY.
records.closure: Environment variables and CLI overrides tested in transport runner.

records.title: Dynamic checklist check counter derivation
records.rule: Derive validation/check counters from actual checklist.
records.absence_reason: tests/b6 asserted hardcoded 8 checks when checklist was updated to 9 checks.
records.negative_contrast: Added check updates expectation / stale hard-coded counter is rejected.
records.mitigation: Derive expected validation counters directly from checklist.json rather than hardcoded literals.
records.closure: Contract tests compute expected counts dynamically from loaded checklists.

records.title: Readable canary font rendering and unambiguous glyphs
records.rule: Real readable font and distinct unambiguous canary glyphs; missing font errors before dispatch.
records.absence_reason: Bitmap atlas fallback lacked letters, causing VQA-C4E93A15 to render as vqa-07893015.
records.negative_contrast: Alphabet renders distinct nonblank glyphs / missing font fails closed.
records.mitigation: Render attention canaries with ffmpeg drawtext using DejaVuSansMono.ttf (>=32px) and alphabet ACDEFHJKLMNPRTUVWXY3479.
records.closure: Canary glyph distinction tests and missing font error tests verify reliable OCR.

records.title: Measured admissions and bounded batching
records.rule: Use measured admissions and bounded batching; account every call.
records.absence_reason: Measured live cost per call reached 135k tokens / 148s, far exceeding initial design estimates.
records.negative_contrast: Excess media split within cap / excess budget refuses dispatch, never assumed cheap.
records.mitigation: Enforce CALL_TIMEOUT_S=480, WALL_BUDGET_S=2400, admission 300k in/call, 1.5M in/run, and max 3 media items/batch.
records.closure: Batch splitting and admission gate policies verified in judge scheduler.

records.title: Subsampled 1 fps judge video copies
records.rule: Video sampling needs explicitly mapped slow judge copies and temporal canaries.
records.absence_reason: Gemini video sampling operates at ~1 fps, missing high-framerate transitions and short canaries.
records.negative_contrast: Selected endpoints and second mapping retained / raw fast clip cannot prove all frames observed.
records.mitigation: Re-encode judge video copies at 1 fps (max 20 frames, uniformly sampled retaining endpoints), recording second-to-render mapping.
records.closure: Judge copy generation and frame mapping verified in media preparation tests.

records.title: Deterministic-only frozen frame detection
records.rule: Frozen-frame detection is deterministic-only in motion windows.
records.absence_reason: Gemini emitted false positive FAIL on clean subtle motion (actors moving 6mm/tick seen at 1 fps).
records.negative_contrast: Subtle real motion passes / identical required-motion frames fail; no judge vote overrides.
records.mitigation: Declare render.frozen deterministic-only with frame.frozen oracle over declared motion windows excluding PAUSED.
records.closure: Checklists bind render.frozen exclusively to deterministic oracle.

records.title: Dual oracle demonstration across adapters
records.rule: Second adapter demonstrates generic deterministic + semantic channels.
records.absence_reason: Initial example_game checklist had deterministic: null on all checks, failing to demonstrate dual oracle.
records.negative_contrast: Clean fixture truthful fake judge + deterministic results / named mutant fails target check.
records.mitigation: Bind generic deterministic oracles (ui.presence, camera.fleet, ui.overlap, frame.black, frame.frozen) in checklist.
records.closure: Verified by offline selftest and example_game calibration matrix.

records.title: PNG observation time zero normalization
records.rule: Only PNG observation time zero may normalize to null, with a note.
records.absence_reason: Model returned time_ms: 0 for PNG still observations which schema required to be null.
records.negative_contrast: Zero is normalized explicitly / nonzero PNG time rejects.
records.mitigation: Normalize time_ms: 0 on PNG observations to null with audit note; nonzero time on PNG remains an error.
records.closure: Validation tests confirm normalization of zero and rejection of non-zero time on PNGs.

records.title: Production evaluation of deterministic oracles
records.rule: Real run evaluates/writes deterministic results; judge/report load them.
records.absence_reason: cli.py previously failed to call oracles.evaluate in run path, leaving deterministic null in report.
records.negative_contrast: Black fixture + fake judge PASS gives FAIL / CLI monkeypatch or unit-only oracle is no production witness.
records.mitigation: cli.py evaluates deterministic oracles, writes results to oracles/results.json, and passes to report reconciliation.
records.closure: tests/b1 production path tests assert deterministic results evaluation and persistence.

records.title: Bounded same-batch transport retry
records.rule: Bounded same-batch transport retry and preserved diagnostics.
records.absence_reason: Transient worker exit rc=1 without retry caused clean run to fail with ERROR.
records.negative_contrast: Failure then valid returns accepted accounted attempt / repeated failure stays ERROR with evidence.
records.mitigation: Retry failed batch once after 20s backoff with fresh attempt ID; preserve worker stdout/stderr/err evidence.
records.closure: Transport retry tests verify single retry on failure and preservation of diagnostic logs.

records.title: Clean baseline qualification and metric accounting
records.rule: Aggregation distinguishes clean errors and false positives; no unknown metrics coerced to zero.
records.absence_reason: Calibration marked all mutants invalid when clean run had transient error; metrics were coerced to zero.
records.negative_contrast: Matching-pin passing clean qualifies mutant comparison / mismatched pin or no passing clean invalidates it.
records.mitigation: A mutant qualifies when at least one clean run passes on the same revision; clean errors reported separately; preserve null metrics.
records.closure: tools/live_calibration.py aggregation tests verify clean error reporting and metric preservation.

records.title: Real arena scene rendering and node telemetry
records.rule: Render real arena and capture actual telemetry/fault receipts.
records.absence_reason: OZ capture hook rendered a solid-colour frame because it did not instantiate the real arena scene.
records.negative_contrast: Nonuniform real scene + nodes + named injection receipt / solid-colour synthetic scene cannot qualify.
records.mitigation: Hook must instantiate and run the real arena scene driven by input journal, capturing real node transforms.
records.closure: Capture verification requires >= 50 distinct colours and real HUD/controls node telemetry.

records.title: Deterministic uniform frame detection
records.rule: Uniform nonblack frames require a dedicated deterministic predicate.
records.absence_reason: No deterministic oracle caught solid green frames rendered by broken scene hooks.
records.negative_contrast: Real multicolour scene passes / uniform green fails independent of black detector.
records.mitigation: Add frame.uniform oracle evaluating distinct colour count and dominant colour ratio.
records.closure: Tested in oracles test suite with uniform green fixture rejection and multicolour arena pass.

records.title: Mandatory scratch project import preflight
records.rule: Scratch import is mandatory before capture; preserve engine logs.
records.absence_reason: Scratch Godot project was not imported, so texture loading failed and Godot rendered only clear color.
records.negative_contrast: Imported texture scene renders / failed import stops before judge even if capture could start.
records.mitigation: Execute godot --headless --editor --import before capture; verify .godot/imported is non-empty; save logs to logs/import.*.

records.title: Complete frame predicate evidence evaluation
records.rule: Complete captures must supply frame predicates with evaluable evidence.
records.absence_reason: render.frozen and render.uniform returned CANNOT_SEE on complete captures due to mismatched point ranges.
records.negative_contrast: Complete motion/uniform evidence yields PASS or FAIL / unexplained CANNOT_SEE stays unresolved.
records.mitigation: Align capture plan timeline and point ranges so all declared checks have evaluable frame evidence.
records.closure: Verified by complete capture oracle evaluation tests.

records.title: Unimplemented game features declared advisory
records.rule: Unimplemented game features are explicitly advisory with revision-scoped reason.
records.absence_reason: oz.fleet.order failed on clean capture because OP-11 fleet formation was not yet implemented in r3 ruleset.
records.negative_contrast: Advisory formation remains visible without gating / same feature silently required or omitted is invalid.
records.mitigation: Mark checks for unimplemented game features as required: false with explicit reason field citing revision scope.
records.closure: Enforced by checklist validator per ruling R-12.

records.title: Comprehensive forbidden UI overlap pairs
records.rule: Forbidden overlap pairs must cover real quick-buy/HUD/help leaves.
records.absence_reason: oz.ui.overlap passed on c820b22 although quick-buy bar overlapped HUD line because pair was omitted.
records.negative_contrast: Corrected layout passes and broken pin fails / missing pair is missing coverage, not proof of nonoverlap.
records.mitigation: Enumerate all interactive and informational UI leaves in forbidden overlap pairs.
records.closure: Verified by contrasting broken pin c820b22 and corrected pin da092319.
